name: workspace.init
title: Create workspace
summary: Create a workspace with the standard model in a folder, which is created when only it is missing, with the folder `evidence` as its evidence location, and write the skill file for AI agents. Adds `*.reqseq-tmp` (temp files of an interrupted write) to the folder's `.gitignore`.
details: The skill file is written as `tool.guide` with `skill` and `write` writes it, without `replace`, at each of its places: `.claude/skills/managing-requirements/SKILL.md` and `.agents/skills/managing-requirements/SKILL.md` in the root of the Git repository of the folder, or in the folder without Git. Each place written is listed in `files`. ReqSeq's own unchanged file of another version is left as it is and not listed. A file at a place that ReqSeq did not write, or that was changed since, is kept, and one problem `workspace.skill-not-written` per place not written says where and why; the other place is written all the same, and the workspace is created all the same. `skill: false` writes no skill file. The folder `evidence` is created with an empty `.gitkeep`, so that Git keeps it, when nothing is at its path; a folder, file or link already there is left as it is; when the folder or `.gitkeep` cannot be created, the workspace is created all the same and the problem `workspace.evidence-folder-not-created` says why.
whileReadOnlyReason: Creates the workspace, so there is no metamodel yet that could make it read-only.

path.description: Folder of the workspace, created when only it is missing; must not contain reqseq-workspace.yaml or the metamodel file.

name.description: Name of the workspace, written to reqseq-workspace.yaml.

metamodel.description: Where the metamodel lies. Default: the folder `metamodel` in the main repository, where the standard model is written.

repository.description: Workspace name of the repository of the metamodel. Default: the main repository.

path.description: Folder of the metamodel, relative to that repository. Default: `metamodel`.

skill.description: Write the skill file for AI agents (`tool.guide` with `skill`). `false`: write none.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root; a skill file is `../…` when the root of its Git repository lies above the workspace folder.

next.title: Next steps
